description:
Extend the polar-code stack with polarization-adjusted convolutional (PAC) codes and automorphism-ensemble decoding (AED), targeting the short-blocklength regime where these approach finite-length optimal performance.

## Background

PAC codes [Arikan2019] prepend a convolutional precoder to the polar transform and approach the finite-length bound at $(128, 64)$ under sequential or large-list decoding; list decoding with $L \ge 128$ matches Fano-decoding performance [Yao2020], and simplified successive-cancellation-list variants reduce complexity further [PacScl2024]. AED runs SC or SCL over an ensemble of automorphism-permuted received words and matches or beats CRC-aided SCL at lower latency on shortened and rate-compatible polar codes [Aed2024], [Rcaed2023]; ensemble members are independent decodes of the same channel output, so the scheme parallelizes naturally onto existing thread/GPU batch paths. Survey context for the 6G decoder landscape: [Rowshan2024]. This epic builds on the 5G NR polar SC/SCL foundation and reuses existing CRC, convolutional-encoding, modem, and channel infrastructure.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: PAC encoding (rate profile, convolutional precoding, polar transform) with list decoding; BLER at $(128, 64)$ on BI-AWGN is consistent with published PAC list-decoding curves.
- [hard] REQ-02: Automorphism-ensemble decoding with configurable ensemble size $M$ reproduces the published accuracy-versus-ensemble-size trade-off on a documented polar code.
- [hard] REQ-03: A short-blocklength comparison campaign (PAC, CRC-aided SCL, and ORBGRAND on the same $(n, k)$ and channel) produces overlaid BLER curves including finite-blocklength reference bounds.
- [aspirational] REQ-04: AED on shortened and rate-compatible constructions.

## References

- [Arikan2019] Arıkan — From Sequential Decoding to Channel Polarization and Back Again (PAC codes). arXiv:1908.09594.
- [Yao2020] Yao, Fazeli, Vardy — List Decoding of Arıkan's PAC Codes. arXiv:2002.06805.
- [PacScl2024] Simplified Successive-Cancellation List Decoding of PAC Codes. arXiv:2401.13922.
- [Aed2024] Shortened Polar Codes under Automorphism Ensemble Decoding. arXiv:2403.00622.
- [Rcaed2023] Rate-Compatible Polar Codes for Automorphism Ensemble Decoding. arXiv:2305.01214.
- [Rowshan2024] Rowshan, Qiu, Xie, Gu, Yuan — Channel Coding Toward 6G: Technical Overview and Outlook. arXiv:2405.07547.
title: PAC codes and automorphism-ensemble decoding for short blocklengths
